name: git
purpose: Distributed version control and repository inspection.
usage_notes: Use status/diff before edits; avoid destructive reset/clean without explicit instruction.

name: gh
purpose: GitHub CLI for pull requests, issues, Actions, and authenticated repository operations.
usage_notes: Prefer structured GitHub MCP tools when available for remote mutations.

name: python3
purpose: Primary Python interpreter for scripts, tests, and automation.
usage_notes: Use the project virtual environment when present.

name: pip3
usage_notes: Inspect project dependency files before installing packages.

name: uv
purpose: Fast Python package and environment manager.

name: pytest
usage_notes: Run focused tests first, then the full relevant suite.

name: docker
usage_notes: Verify daemon availability separately from CLI presence.

name: bash
purpose: GNU Bourne Again Shell used by host_run_command.

name: curl
purpose: HTTP and general URL transfer client.

name: openssl
purpose: TLS, certificate, hashing, and cryptographic CLI.

name: nmap
purpose: Network service discovery and port scanning.
usage_notes: Use only against systems the user is authorized to assess.

name: file
purpose: Identify file formats using magic signatures.

name: strings
purpose: Extract printable strings from binary files.

name: objdump
purpose: Display object and executable file information.

name: binwalk
purpose: Firmware and embedded file signature analysis.

name: ffmpeg
purpose: Audio and video conversion and inspection.

name: theHarvester
purpose: Email, subdomain, IP, and virtual host enumeration from public sources.
usage_notes: Supports sources: google, bing, baidu, yahoo, crtsh, dnsdumpster, hunter, threatcrowd, etc.

name: sherlock
usage_notes: Use --timeout to avoid rate limits; --output for results file.

name: holehe
purpose: Check if an email is registered on various web services.
usage_notes: Supports --only-used and --no-color flags.

name: maigret
purpose: Advanced username search across 2500+ sites with rich report output.
usage_notes: Generates HTML/JSON reports; supports --pdf, --all-sites, --retries.

name: shodan
purpose: Shodan API client for Internet-connected device search.
usage_notes: Requires API key (SHODAN_API_KEY); subcommands: search, host, scan, info.

name: censys
purpose: Censys search and enumeration CLI for Internet assets.
usage_notes: Requires CENSYS_API_ID and CENSYS_API_SECRET env vars.

name: whatweb
purpose: Fingerprint web technologies, CMS versions, and server info.
usage_notes: Use --aggression 3 for aggressive probing; output formats: --log-json, --log-verbose.

name: dnsrecon
purpose: DNS enumeration with SRV, MX, AAAA, zone transfer, reverse lookup and brute force.
usage_notes: Use -d for domain, -t for type (std, brt, srv, axfr, etc.).

name: whois
purpose: Query domain registration and IP whois databases.
usage_notes: Directly follow with domain or IP; -h for whois server override.

name: nikto
usage_notes: Use -h for target; -ssl for HTTPS; -Tuning for test selection.

name: sqlmap
purpose: Automated SQL injection detection and exploitation.
usage_notes: Use -u for URL; --batch for non-interactive; --dump to extract data.

name: ffuf
purpose: Fast web fuzzer for directory/parameter discovery.
usage_notes: Use -u for URL with FUZZ keyword; -w for wordlist; -recursion for recursive scanning.

name: gobuster
purpose: Directory/file and DNS subdomain brute force.
usage_notes: Modes: dir, dns, vhost; use -u for URL, -w for wordlist.

name: hydra
purpose: Network login brute-force (SSH, FTP, HTTP, MySQL, etc.).
usage_notes: Use -l for user, -P for password list, -t for threads, -V for verbose.

name: john
usage_notes: Use john hashfile --wordlist=wordlist.txt; --rules for mangling rules.

name: hashcat
usage_notes: Use -m for hash mode, -a for attack mode, -o for output file.

name: radare2
purpose: Advanced binary analysis and reverse engineering framework.
usage_notes: Commands: aaa (analyze), afl (list functions), VV (graph mode), s (seek).

name: ghidra
usage_notes: Launch headless: ghidraHeadless; standard: ghidraRun.

name: checksec
purpose: Check binary security properties (PIE, NX, RELRO, Stack Canary, FORTIFY).
usage_notes: Use --file=./binary to inspect a single binary; runs with pwntools.

name: ROPgadget
purpose: Find ROP gadgets in ELF/PE binaries for exploit development.
usage_notes: Use --binary for file; --ropchain to auto-generate chain.

name: one_gadget
purpose: Find one-shot RCE gadgets in glibc (execve /bin/sh).
usage_notes: Pass libc binary as argument; shows constraints for each gadget.

name: steghide
purpose: Hide/extract data in/from image and audio files.
usage_notes: Use embed -cf coverfile -ef datafile; extract -sf stegofile; needs passphrase.

name: foremost
purpose: File carving tool that recovers files based on headers/footers.
usage_notes: Use -i input_file -o output_dir; -t for file type selection.

name: vol
usage_notes: Subcommands: windows.info, linux.pslist, windows.filescan, etc.

name: tcpdump
usage_notes: Use -i for interface; -w to write; -r to read; filter with BPF syntax.

name: wireshark
usage_notes: Supports live capture and pcap analysis; use tshark for CLI.

name: netcat
purpose: TCP/UDP Swiss-army knife for network debugging and CTF exploitation.
usage_notes: nc host port; nc -lvp port for listener; -e for exec (legacy).

name: ncat
purpose: Improved Nmap netcat with SSL support and connection brokering.
usage_notes: ncat --ssl host port for SSL connections; -l for listener.

name: socat
purpose: Multi-purpose relay for bidirectional data transfer.
usage_notes: socat TCP-LISTEN:port,fork TCP:host:port for port forwarding.

name: binwalk
purpose: Firmware and embedded file signature analysis.
usage_notes: Use -Me for recursive extraction; -D for custom carve rules.

name: exiv2
purpose: EXIF metadata reader used to cross-check exiftool GPS values.
usage_notes: Disagreement between exiftool and exiv2 must be reported as conflicting evidence, never silently merged.
Example: exiv2 -pa file.jpg | grep -i gps

name: exiftran
purpose: JPEG orientation normalization for consistent heading math.

name: ffprobe
purpose: Multimedia stream inspection (format, streams, duration, GPS location tags in video).
usage_notes: Use -print_format json for machine-readable output.

name: tesseract
purpose: OCR engine for reading text embedded in images.
usage_notes: Run duachuot_ocr_probe; verify low-confidence reads against pixels.

name: sleuthkit
purpose: Disk image analysis: fls, fsstat, icat, mmls.
usage_notes: Preserve originals; use offset-aware commands.

name: volatility3
purpose: Volatility 3 launcher alias for python3 -m volatility3.

name: stegsolve
purpose: Image channel/plane analysis for LSB steganography.
usage_notes: GUI tool; automate with zsteg when available.

name: gpsbabel
purpose: Convert between GPS track/waypoint formats (GPX, KML, NMEA).
usage_notes: Not installed by default; flagged as optional in Tool Matrix.

name: gdal
purpose: GDAL geospatial data processing (convert.py prefers pure-python; gdal is optional).
usage_notes: Optional; Geo Engine is pure-python and offline.

name: proj
usage_notes: Optional; only for validation of datum results.
